categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains legal orders modifying degree program requirements and conditions for private educational institutions, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of the Minister serves to establish the legal authority for the order rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
